handoff.nextCommand: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $repo = if ($env:AGENT_SWITCHBOARD_REPO) { $env:AGENT_SWITCHBOARD_REPO } else { Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'dev\AgentSwitchBoard-Live' }; Set-Location -LiteralPath $repo; git fetch --all --prune --tags; if (git status --porcelain) { git status --short; throw 'Checkout dirty; preserve work before continuing.' }; git switch main; git pull --ff-only origin main; $ev = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA ('AgentSwitchboard\runtime-proof\fm-asb-observation\' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddTHHmmssZ')); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $ev | Out-Null; Write-Host "EVIDENCE_ROOT=$ev"; Write-Host 'Provide FM_HOME to an authorized live FirstMate home (not ~/.cache/asb-fm-observation/disposable-home-*), then:'; Write-Host 'wsl -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc "export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH; export FM_HOME=<authorized-home>; <firstmate-pin>/bin/fm-fleet-snapshot.sh --json > /mnt/c/.../live-fm-fleet-snapshot.json"'; Write-Host 'Then run emit_agent_observation.py against that snapshot and record a new local receipt.'
